name_reason: The 'sprite_id' token is factually wrong: the value is an FDTXT page/text index, not a sprite id. The dialog VM fd2_display_dialog_scene (0x16067) reads this global on the -4 (0xFFFC) RECURSIVE opcode and re-enters itself with it as the page_idx argument to render an embedded sub-dialog. Every writer stores a text id (item_id+0xB5 = FDTXT item-name text base, portrait_id+1, char_id+1) -- never a sprite/portrait sprite handle. The structurally identical sibling at 0x53ADD (the -5 RECURSIVE opcode source) is named data_fd2_dialog_drop_swap_text_id_param, i.e. '_text_id_param'; renaming this to data_fd2_dialog_last_action_text_id_param makes the pair consistent and removes the misnomer. Domain prefix data_fd2_dialog_ preserved; no address residue. Record only; rename applied in Stage 2.
purpose: Transient dialog-VM parameter holding the FDTXT page/text index that the dialog interpreter loads and re-enters itself with when it hits the -4 RECURSIVE sub-dialog opcode.
logic_summary: Single READ in fd2_display_dialog_scene @ 0x1609x: on opcode -4 (0xFFFC) it copies this global into a local and calls fd2_display_dialog_scene recursively passing it as page_idx (the same code path also handles -5 via the sibling drop_swap global). 14 WRITE sites across shop buy/sell/give, revive, class-promotion, battle-drop XP/level-up, party-membership and field-map tile-event (chest/gold/event) handlers; each stores an FDTXT text id (item_id+0xB5, runtime_char.bPortrait_id+1, or char_id+1) immediately before invoking the dialog scene so that the sub-dialog renders the corresponding item-name / character line. The dialog VM never interprets this as a sprite: the -0x11..-0x14 sprite-loading opcodes take their id inline from the next u16 in the bytecode stream, not from this global.
element_semantics: Scalar. FDTXT page/text-chunk index (16-bit value range in practice; stored as a 32-bit cell). Carries values such as item_id+0xB5 (FDTXT item-name text base), portrait_id+1, char_id+1.
comment_original_issue: None material. The src comment block above the definition (shop.c lines 808-820) already correctly describes this as a transient dialog-VM parameter / FDTXT page-text index used by the -4 RECURSIVE opcode, lists the typical written values, and notes it is a zero-init BSS scalar. The only cosmetic mismatch is that the comment header echoes the current symbol name token 'sprite_id'; that is acceptable until the Stage 2 rename lands (which updates the header along with the symbol).
notes: Reader is fd2_display_dialog_scene @ 0x16067 (its own plate already documents opcode -4 as 'RECURSIVE: sub-dialog at last_action_sprite_id'). xrefs: 1 READ (0x16067) + 14 WRITE. Memory at 0x53AD9 is all zero (BSS/.object2) -> zero-init scalar, not a const table -> is_const=false. No prior Ghidra data plate existed (was null); created a concise PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline reflecting the src conclusion (purpose, -4 opcode role, sibling 0x53ADD/0x53AE1, and the pending sprite_id->text_id rename note), then save_program succeeded. No src edit needed (comment kept).
